name: AWS Secret Access Key
description: AWS secret access key; requires contextual validation alongside Access Key ID.

name: PEM Private Key
description: PEM private key block should be redacted.

name: OpenSSH Private Key
pattern: -----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----[\s\S]{100,}?-----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----

name: Generic High-Entropy Secret
description: Generic high-entropy string; requires contextual variable name or entropy threshold to raise confidence.

name: API Key Variable Context
description: Contextual variable assignment for API keys; capture named group 'secret'.

name: GCP Service Account Private Key
description: GCP service account private key embedded in JSON service account files.
recommendedAction: Rotate the service account key and remove from repository; use Secret Manager or Workload Identity Federation.

name: GitHub Personal Access Token (fine-grained)
description: GitHub fine-grained Personal Access Token (contains 'github_pat_' prefix).
recommendedAction: Revoke the token, remove from history, and use GitHub Apps or Secrets.

name: EC Private Key PEM
pattern: -----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----[\s\S]{100,}?-----END EC PRIVATE KEY-----
description: Unarmoured EC private key PEM block found in source.
recommendedAction: Remove private key material immediately, rotate keys, and use a managed KMS.

name: Azure Client Secret
description: Azure client secret or application secret assigned in code or config.
recommendedAction: Rotate the credential and move it to Azure Key Vault; invalidate leaked values.

name: Redis Connection URI with Credentials
description: Redis connection URI that includes plaintext credentials (redis://:password@host:port).
recommendedAction: Remove plaintext credentials, rotate secrets, and use environment-based secret injection.

name: MongoDB Connection String with Credentials
description: MongoDB connection string containing username/password in the URI.
recommendedAction: Remove plaintext credentials from source and use a secrets manager or connection string template with injected secrets.
